name: agent-manager.investigate
purpose: Start one durable, caller-keyed Agent Manager investigation for a generic subject and collect its bounded structured result once.

subject_kind.description: Generic subject kind, such as plan, run, scenario, or cohort.

question.description: Bounded diagnostic question; it cannot authorize mutation.

run_ids.description: Explicit subject run IDs used as evidence, at most eight.

evidence_refs.description: Optional bounded typed evidence references supplied by the caller; exact citations only.

wait_seconds.description: One bounded collect wait, capped at 300 seconds.

assumptions: agent-manager declares agent-manager/investigate-typed and owns the diagnosis-only execution
the delegated workflow performs diagnosis only; recommendation application requires a separate reviewed operation
agent.collect waits for the durable terminal transition once and is never polled
invariants: exactly one agent.start and at most one agent.collect
stable caller_key is used as the downstream idempotency key; generic subject identity and evidence run IDs are included in the delegated input
this program cannot apply recommendations or mutate the subject
the envelope is printed exactly once on every path

signals.summary: Durable execution identity, terminal status, bounded result metadata, and diagnosis-only disposition

outputs.evidence: Durable execution identity and subject/caller keys; never unbounded transcript content

budget.async_reason: agent diagnosis may exceed the synchronous submission bound; submit asynchronously and wait once
